claims.claim_text: PyTorch 2.15 was released on October 28, 2026, composed of 3,117 commits from 583 contributors since PyTorch 2.14.
claims.excerpt: This release is composed of 3,117 commits from 583 contributors since PyTorch 2.14.

claims.claim_text: In PyTorch 2.15 the rewritten NCCL backend is the default for every nccl process group, with TORCH_DIST_USE_NCCL2=0 or the nccl-legacy backend name as rollback paths.
claims.excerpt: In 2.15 it is the default for every nccl process group, with TORCH_DIST_USE_NCCL2=0 and the nccl-legacy backend name as rollback paths.

claims.claim_text: A backend-agnostic flight recorder writes a post-mortem to disk when a collective hangs, and a timeout on any rank triggers flight-recorder dumps from every rank.
claims.excerpt: a backend-agnostic flight recorder writes a post-mortem to disk when a collective hangs, and watchdog health is published to the debug server so a timeout on any rank triggers flight-recorder dumps from every rank.

claims.claim_text: torch.distributed gains a Python transport API for one-sided data movement with NIXL as the first backend, and transfers can be captured with torch.cuda.graph; the API is marked unstable.
claims.excerpt: torch.distributed gains a Python transport API for one-sided data movement, with NIXL as the first backend.

claims.claim_text: PyTorch says the new MPS grouped_mm gemv path gives 1.32–1.34x higher MoE decode throughput on an M3 Ultra.
claims.excerpt: the new MPS grouped_mm has a gemv path that gives 1.32–1.34x higher MoE decode throughput on an M3 Ultra.

claims.claim_text: PyTorch says QR of a 512 x 512 matrix on MPS falls from about 7 seconds to 1.5 ms after linear algebra solvers were rewritten.
claims.excerpt: QR of a 512 x 512 matrix falls from about 7 seconds to 1.5 ms, and triangular solves are now blocked.

claims.claim_text: torch.float8_e4m3fn and _scaled_mm with tensorwise or rowwise scaling are now supported on MPS (Apple Silicon), along with a public torch.mps.Stream API.
claims.excerpt: torch.float8_e4m3fn is now supported on MPS, along with _scaled_mm with tensorwise or rowwise scaling and a gemv fast path for decode-sized shapes.

claims.claim_text: The default PyTorch wheel moves to CUDA 13.2, with CUDA 13.4 wheels shipping alongside it and adding experimental support for NVIDIA Rubin GPUs.
claims.excerpt: The CUDA 13.4 wheels add experimental support for NVIDIA Rubin GPUs.

claims.claim_text: PyTorch 2.15 adds ROCm 10.0 wheels, built on AMD's TheRock packages, and Dynamo adds Python 3.15 support (Python 3.11 through 3.15 supported).
claims.excerpt: PyTorch 2.15 adds ROCm 10.0 wheels alongside the ROCm 7.14 wheels introduced in 2.14.

claims.claim_text: PyTorch 2.15 drops Python 3.10 support (requires 3.11 or newer) and requires macOS 15 or newer for MPS acceleration.
claims.excerpt: Python 3.10 is no longer supported. PyTorch 2.15 requires Python 3.11 or newer
